title: L4-L5 intact neutral zone (Heuer 2007a)

quantity.name: neutral zone
quantity.definition: NZ per direction = rotation between the 0 Nm intersection of the hysteresis loop and the median neutral position, evaluated in the test run to each peak moment; median over specimens (no spread reported)

source.authors: Heuer F, Schmidt H, Klezl Z, Claes L, Wilke HJ
source.sample: fresh-frozen human L4-L5 segments, no bony defects, low degeneration (Mimura grade <2); 8 human cadaveric L4-L5 FSUs evaluated (two further specimens failed at 10 Nm flexion after posterior-element removal and were excluded); n=3 at 10 Nm for stages w/oFC to w/oNUC

protocol.summary: Pure unconstrained moments 1, 2.5, 5, 7.5, 10 Nm in flexion/extension, right/left lateral bending, left/right axial rotation; 1.0 deg/s; 2.5 load cycles, first 1.5 = preconditioning, last cycle evaluated; no preload during testing (15 min 500 N axial compression before testing to reduce water content). Ulm spine tester (Wilke 1994): L5 caudal end potted in PMMA and fixed; L4 cranial end potted and attached to gimbal free in all 5 other DOF. Rotations by potentiometers in gimbal.
how_to_simulate: Fix the inferior (caudal) half of L5; leave L4 free in all DOF (no follower or axial preload)
Apply pure moments of 1, 2.5, 5, 7.5 and 10 Nm to L4 in flexion, extension, right lateral bending and left axial rotation
Report L4 rotation relative to L5 at each peak moment (loading branch of the evaluated cycle), one-sided from the neutral posture of the intact specimen
Compare with medians; tabulated directions are flexion, extension, right lateral bending and left axial rotation only
protocol.notes: ROM = maximal rotation at the applied moment in one direction, related to a median neutral position (mid-point of NZ intersections averaged over the 5 moments) and, for defect stages, offset by the lordosis-angle change so all stages share the intact starting posture (Fig. 3). Coupled motions not evaluated (stated in Discussion). Resection order: INTACT -> w/oSSL -> w/oISL -> w/oFL -> w/oFC -> w/oVA -> w/oPLL -> w/oALL -> w/oNUC (cumulative). Absolute values (deg), not % intact.

extraction.check_notes: Parsed from text layer; compared cell-by-cell with Table 2.

pass_rule.rule: |model-median| <= max(0.3 deg, 50% of median) (no spread reported)

shared_sample_with: wilke2025: Heuer 2007a/b listed in Wilke 2025 Table 4 (n=8 L4-L5) - pooled into Wilke 2025 L4-L5 data
kettler2011: Ulm database 7.5 Nm lumbar segments of ~2000-2010 likely include these specimens (not itemised)
schmidt2007: Fig 6 re-plots this group's intact and w/oSSL&ISL flexion/extension at 7.5 Nm
